Fist Ernestus is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found on the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.
“
If this lot have got a problem with the Gazette they should take it up with the editor, not make a scene in the streets.
„
— Ernestus

Involvement

Act Three

Ernestus is patrolling the streets of Lower City. He can be found at X: 43 Y: -71, arguing with a group of Baldurians ( Saer Frunilla,  Wuloona Dor,  Porter Juxon, and  Bliggerillo). They are slandering aloud the contents of latest issues of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette and blaming the newspaper (and  Gortash as well) for sweeping under the rug obvious crimes that happen in the city.

Ernestus's reaction to the player character might differ depending on the positive / negative article printed about them in the Baldur's Mouth Gazette (or neither printed at all), as an outcome for ⁠Stop the Presses quest. Also, he might notice if the party try to break in and enter any restricted areas nearby (e.g., Old Jol's house or the backdoor of the Nortale's Hostel), and react accordingly.

If Gortash is defeated, Ernestus and the rest of the group disperse, and cannot be found or interacted with again.

Idle banter

  • Wuloona Dor
    You see the latest issue of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette? Streets are safer than they've even been, apparently.
  • Wuloona Dor
    Not a word on all the thefts and murders happening right on our doorsteps!
  • Porter Juxon
    Nowhere's safe any more, no matter how many Steel Watchers Lord Gortash tries to jam down our throats.
  • Wuloona Dor
    If you ask me, I don't think Gortash even deserves to be called a lord.
  • Fist Ernestus
    That's enough of that! Lord Gortash has everything under control - we don't need agitators like you ruining morale.
  • Wuloona Dor
    What are you gonna do? Arrest us?
  • Fist Ernestus
    If that what it takes to keep the peace!
  • Wuloona Dor
    If you say so, mate.
  • Porter Juxon
    Why would they go to all that effort just to lie to us?
  • Wuloona Dor
    It's obvious, isn't it? To placate us. To keep us all nice and obedient.
  • Wuloona Dor
    They don't like it when we think too much - we might question their authority.
  • Fist Ernestus
    I'm warning you...
  • Porter Juxon
    There's one of you and four of us - do you really think you can take all of us at once?
  • Fist Ernestus
    I... I can go and get back up.
  • Wuloona Dor
    And do you think we're just gonna sit here and wait for you and your hog friends to come back and arrest us?
  • Fist Ernestus
    Look, I'm just trying to do my job, all right?
  • Porter Juxon
    So what can we do about it? All the lies they're publishing, I mean.
  • Wuloona Dor
    Not a lot unless you want to set fire to the Baldur's Mouth Gazette headquarters.
  • Fist Ernestus
    I'm still right here, you know...
  • Wuloona Dor
    Tch, we do know, thank you - we just don't care.
  • Wuloona Dor
    Besides, I don't think that'd achieve much in the long run. The problem's at the top - it always is.
  • Porter Juxon
    Perhaps sending a strongly worded letter would be a good place to start?
  • Wuloona Dor
    If by 'strongly worded letter' you mean a brick through a window, then aye.
  • Porter Juxon
    I'm just not one for violence, you see...
  • Wuloona Dor
    You'd better start acquiring a taste for it - it's only gonna get worse from here on out.
